title: Dirichlet and Beta forward sampling implementation uses `jnp.finfo` in a deprecated way
author: dylanhmorris

comments.author: dylanhmorris
comments.body:
Searched the code and found one other instance of `jnp.finfo` called on an array rather than on a `dtype`. Will fix in the same PR.

https://github.com/pyro-ppl/numpyro/blob/78c366530db3c26075a63dba370ad002b17b006a/numpyro/distributions/discrete.py#L1059

search query: https://github.com/search?q=repo%3Apyro-ppl%2Fnumpyro%20finfo&type=code

comments.body: I think I see what's going on here. Going to put together a fix.
